answers: RLREDTEAM-2: done — Added a new outside assumption explicitly acknowledging that GitHub's REST API for issue comments does not guarantee instantaneous cross-connection visibility after a POST. The assumption names the residual race (both runs complete their note-post-and-read cycle within GitHub's sub-second replication window, see only their own note, and both return `{"acquired": true}`), explains why closing it is not feasible (requires a sleep, which the determinism rules prohibit in tests and would slow every claim in production), and states that the residual probability is accepted. It also notes that ADR-005 §5 will document this. This satisfies the finding's acceptance condition: "the design acknowledges the residual window where both runs proceed and states why it is acceptable."
